zh: （令人厌烦地）多次重复的，频繁的
接连不断的；连续的；频频的
en: repeated many times in a way that is annoying
ex: continual complaints/interruptions
反复的抱怨／打搅

zh: （令人厌烦地）多次重复的，频繁的
in a way that continues without a break
en: in a way that is repeated many times so that it is annoying
ex: They argue continually about money.
他们没完没了地为钱争吵。

en: the state of continuing to exist or function
ex: We can no longer support the President's continuance in office.
我们不能再支持总统继续任职。

en: connected with the type of consonant called a continuant
ex: continuant consonants
延续辅音

en: an act or the state of continuing
ex: They are anxious to ensure the continuation of the economic reform programme.
他们渴望确保经济改革计划持续下去。

zh: 持续；继续存在；不断发生
en: to keep existing or happening without stopping
ex: If the current trend continues, that number will increase 165 per cent by 2050.
如果目前的趋势继续下去，到2050年，这一数字将增加165％。

zh: 继续不变的；连续不断的
en: existing in the same state without change or a break
ex: We are grateful for your continued/continuing support.
我们对你们始终不渝的支持不胜感激。

zh: education for adults that is available outside the formal education system, for example at evening classes or over the internet
en: education for adults that is available outside the formal education system, for example at evening classes or over the internet
ex: We have a thriving continuing education department.
我们有一个蓬勃发展的继续教育部门。

zh: （电影或电视节目场景中服装、物体等的）一致性，衔接
en: the fact of not stopping or not changing
ex: to ensure/provide/maintain continuity of fuel supplies
确保／提供／保持燃料供给的连续性

en: a musical part played with another instrument, in which a line of low notes is shown with figures to represent the higher notes to be played above them
ex: a trio for two violins and continuo
两小提琴与通奏低音的三声中部

zh: connected with the form of a verb (for example I am waiting or It is raining) that is made from a part of be and the present participle. Progressive forms are used to express an action that continues for a period of time.
en: happening or existing for a period of time without being interrupted
ex: Recovery after the accident will be a continuous process that may take several months.
事故发生后的恢复将是一个连续的过程，可能需要几个月的时间。

zh: 连续性评定（学生的最后成绩不是根据一次考试而是根据课程作业）
en: a system of giving a student a final mark based on work done during a course of study rather than on one exam
ex: The final grade depends heavily on coursework and continuous assessment.
最终成绩很大程度上取决于课程作业和持续评估。

zh: a variable for which any value within a set range is possible
en: a variable for which any value within a set range is possible
ex: Age was reported as a continuous variable.
年龄是一个连续变量。

en: in a way that happens or exists for a period of time without being interrupted
ex: He has lived and worked in France almost continuously since 1990.
自从 1990 年以来，他差不多一直在法国居住和工作。

zh: （相邻两者相似但起首与末尾截然不同的）连续体
en: a series of similar items in which each is almost the same as the ones next to it but the last is very different from the first
ex: It is impossible to say at what point along the continuum a dialect becomes a separate language.
要说出同一语言的方言差异到什么程度才成为另一种语言是不可能的。

en: to become twisted or make something twisted out of its natural or normal shape
ex: His face contorted with anger.
他脸都气歪了。

zh: twisted so that the natural or normal shape is lost
complicated and hard to believe or understand
en: twisted so that the natural or normal shape is lost
ex: contorted limbs/bodies
扭曲的四肢／躯体

en: a movement that twists the face or body out of its natural shape; the state of being twisted in this way
ex: His facial contortions amused the audience of schoolchildren.
他扮鬼脸逗得小学生观众都笑起来了。

en: a performer who does contortions of their body to entertain others

zh: （地图上连接相同海拔各点的）等高线
en: the outer edges of something; the outline of its shape or form
ex: The road follows the natural contours of the coastline.
这条路沿着海岸线的自然轮廓延伸。

en: with a specially designed outline that makes something attractive or comfortable
ex: It is smoothly contoured to look like a racing car.
这辆车外形设计流畅，看起来像赛车。

en: against; opposite
ex: contraflow
一侧双向行驶

zh: （非法带入或带出国境的）禁运品，走私货
en: goods that are illegally taken into or out of a country
ex: contraband goods
违禁货物

zh: with a range of notes one octave below that of a bass instrument
en: with a range of notes one octave below that of a bass instrument
ex: a contrabass clarinet
倍低音单簧管。

zh: a bassoon that is larger and longer than the normal type and produces lower notes
en: a bassoon that is larger and longer than the normal type and produces lower notes
the practice of using artificial methods to avoid becoming pregnant when having sex; the methods of doing this
ex: to give advice about contraception
就避孕方法提供咨询

zh: 避孕药；避孕用具；避孕措施
en: used to prevent a woman from becoming pregnant
ex: a contraceptive pill
避孕药丸

en: an official written agreement
ex: All employees have a written contract of employment.
每个员工都有一份书面聘用合同。

zh: 定约桥牌（桥牌的标准形式，只能按叫到的定约取得成局奖分）
en: the standard form of the card game bridge, in which points are given only for sets of cards that are bid and won
to formally agree that you will take part in something
ex: You are strongly advised to contract into the scheme.
强烈建议您签订该计划。

zh: 订约不参与；退出（或不参加）…合约
en: to formally agree that you will not take part in something
ex: Many employees contracted out of the pension plan.
许多雇员退出了养老金计划的合约。

zh: 可收缩的；（开口或管）可变窄的
en: able to contract or, of an opening or tube, become narrower

zh: （肌肉的）收缩，挛缩；（尤指分娩时的）子宫收缩
en: the process of becoming smaller
ex: The design needs to allow for the expansion and contraction of the metal.
设计需要考虑到金属的膨胀和收缩。

zh: 承包人；承包商；承包公司
en: a person or company that has a contract to do work or provide goods or services for another company
ex: a building/roofing/electrical contractor
建筑/屋顶/电力承包商

zh: 合同的；契约的；按合同（或契约）规定的
en: connected with the conditions of a legal written agreement; agreed in a contract
ex: We have contractual obligations to control prices.
我们有控制价格的合同义务。

zh: 合同的；契约的；按合同（或契约）规定的
en: in a way that is connected with the conditions of a legal written agreement, or that is agreed in a contract
ex: The landowner is contractually obliged to maintain and conserve the land.
土地所有者有合约义务维护和保护土地。

en: to say that something that somebody else has said is wrong, and that the opposite is true
ex: All evening her husband contradicted everything she said.
整个晚上她说什么丈夫都反驳。

zh: （事实、看法、行动等的）不一致，矛盾，对立
en: a lack of agreement between facts, opinions, actions, etc.
ex: There is a contradiction between the two sets of figures.
这两组数据相互矛盾。

zh: 相互矛盾的；对立的；不一致的
en: containing or showing a lack of agreement between statements, facts, opinions or actions
ex: We are faced with two apparently contradictory statements.
我们面前这两种说法显然是矛盾的。

zh: talking about something that is not true. ‘Pretend’ and ‘wish’ are contrafactive verbs.
en: talking about something that is not true. ‘Pretend’ and ‘wish’ are contrafactive verbs.

zh: （道路一侧关闭维修时实行的）一侧双向行驶
en: a system that is used when one half of a large road is closed for repairs, and the traffic going in both directions has to use the other half
ex: A contraflow system is in operation on this section of the motorway.
这段高速公路的一侧正在实行双向行驶。

zh: （飞机在高空留下的）水汽尾迹，凝结尾迹，拉烟
en: the white line that is left in the sky by a plane
ex: Contrails crossing clear skies can form beautiful patterns.
穿越晴朗天空的轨迹可以形成美丽的图案。

zh: 禁忌使用（某种药物或疗法）
en: if a drug or treatment is contraindicated, there is a medical reason why it should not be used in a particular situation
ex: This drug is contraindicated in patients with asthma.
这种药哮喘病人禁用。

en: a medical reason for not giving somebody a particular drug or medical treatment
ex: Age alone is not a contraindication to surgery.
单靠年龄并不是手术的禁忌症。

zh: a singing voice with a lower range than that of a soprano; a person with a contralto voice
en: a singing voice with a lower range than that of a soprano; a person with a contralto voice

zh: 奇异的机械；奇特的装置
en: a machine or piece of equipment that looks strange or complicated and possibly does not work well
ex: She showed us a strange contraption that looked like a satellite dish.
她给我们看了一个奇怪的玩意儿，样子像碟形卫星信号接收器。

en: having two or more tunes played together to form a whole

zh: a person who opposes or rejects popular opinion, especially in financial markets
en: a person who opposes or rejects popular opinion, especially in financial markets
ex: Contrarians warned that the stock markets' giant gains were not justified.
反对派人士警告称，股市的大幅上涨是没有道理的。

zh: a child who behaves contrarily behaves badly by deliberately doing the opposite of what is wanted or expected
en: a child who behaves contrarily behaves badly by deliberately doing the opposite of what is wanted or expected

zh: 乖戾的；好与人作对的；逆反的；犟的
en: the quality in children of behaving badly or of choosing to do or say the opposite of what is expected

zh: （用于句首或从句的开头以引出对比）相反，在另一方面
en: used at the beginning of a sentence or clause to introduce a contrast
ex: You can only vote if you are a member. Contrariwise, not all members have the right to vote.
如果您是会员，则只能投票。相反，并非所有成员都有投票权。

zh: 与之相异的；相对立的；相反的
（在性质或方向上）截然不同的，完全相反的
en: different from something; against something
ex: Contrary to popular belief, many cats dislike milk.
与普遍的看法相反，许多猫不喜欢牛奶。

zh: （摄影或绘画中的）颜色反差，明暗对比
（照片或电视图像的）明暗对比度，反差
en: a difference between two or more people or things that you can see clearly when they are compared or put close together; the fact of comparing two or more things in order to show the differences between them
ex: The two cities make an interesting contrast.
两座城市形成了有意思的对照。

zh: （在式样、颜色或态度上）极不相同的，差异大的
en: very different in style, colour or attitude
ex: bright, contrasting colours
鲜艳斑斓的色彩

en: showing the differences between things, especially between languages
ex: a contrastive analysis of British and Australian English
对英式英语和澳大利亚英语的对比分析

en: to do something that is not allowed by a law or rule
ex: The company was found guilty of contravening safety regulations.
那家公司被判违反了安全条例。

en: the fact of doing something that is not allowed by a law or rule
ex: These actions are in contravention of European law.
这些行动违反了欧洲的法律。

zh: 不幸事情；令人难堪的龃龉
en: an unpleasant event or an embarrassing occasion when people disagree
ex: They have been ignoring me since our last contretemps.
自从我们最后一次冲突以来，他们一直无视我。

zh: 捐献，捐赠（尤指金钱或物品）；捐助
（为报纸、杂志、电台或电视节目）撰稿；（在会议或会谈期间）讲话，（尤指）发表意见
en: to give something, especially money or goods, to help achieve or provide something
ex: Do you wish to contribute?
你想捐助吗？

zh: （给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等津贴的）定期缴款
（书、杂志、广播、讨论等部分内容的）一则，一条，稿件
en: a gift or payment that is made to a person or an organization in order to help pay for something
ex: All contributions will be gratefully received.
我们对所有捐资表示感谢。

zh: （杂志或书的）撰稿人，投稿人；（电台、电视节目中的）嘉宾；（会议的）发言人
捐款者；捐赠者；作出贡献者
en: a person who writes articles for a magazine, book or website, or who talks on a radio or television programme or at a meeting
ex: a regular contributor to this magazine
该杂志的定期撰稿人

zh: 促成的；促进的；起作用的
en: helping to cause something
ex: Alcohol is a contributory factor in 10 per cent of all road accidents.
酒精是所有道路交通事故的10％。

en: very sorry for something bad that you have done
ex: Her expression was contrite.
她的表情是悔恨的。

en: in a way that shows that you are very sorry for something bad that you have done
the feeling of being very sorry for something bad that you have done
ex: a look of contrition
追悔莫及的神色

zh: 非自然之物；人工产物；矫揉造作
精巧（或复杂）的装置；专用工具
计谋；圈套；采用计谋（或圈套）
en: something that somebody has done or written that does not seem natural; the fact of seeming artificial
ex: The film is spoilt by unrealistic contrivances of plot.
这部电影被不实际的牵强情节给毁了。

zh: 巧妙地策划；精巧地制造（如机器）
en: to manage to do something despite difficulties
ex: She contrived to spend a couple of hours with him every Sunday evening.
每周星期日晚上她都设法与他待上几个小时。

zh: 预谋的；不自然的；人为的；做作的
en: planned in advance and not natural or what somebody claims it is; written or arranged in a way that is not natural or realistic
ex: a contrived situation
人为的状况

zh: （对国家、地区、机构等的）管理权，控制权，支配权
限制；限定；约束；管理；管制
（机器或车辆的）操纵装置，开关，按钮
en: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
ex: The party expects to gain control of the council in the next election.
该党希望在下次选举中获得对议会的控制。

zh: a place from which an organization or system is managed, or in which devices and controls are kept
en: a place from which an organization or system is managed, or in which devices and controls are kept
ex: Every morning 8 500 London buses are overseen by the biggest traffic control centre in the world.
每天早晨，世界上最大的交通管制中心对8500辆伦敦公共汽车进行监督。

zh: 好多管事的人；爱指挥别人的人
en: a person who always wants to be in control of their own and others’ lives, and to organize how things are done
ex: I'm a bit of a control freak—I much prefer driving to being a passenger.
我有点控制狂-我更喜欢开车而不是乘客。

zh: a room that is a centre for the operation of a factory, a service or a particular event
en: a room that is a centre for the operation of a factory, a service or a particular event
ex: a nuclear power plant's control room
核电站的控制室

zh: （机场的）指挥塔台，控制塔，指挥调度台
en: a building at an airport from which the movements of aircraft are controlled

zh: 可控制（或管理、操纵、支配）的
en: that can be controlled
ex: Cooking with gas is fast, controllable and clean.
用气体烹饪快速，可控且清洁。

zh: 十分小心完成的；精心安排的
（受法律或规则）限制的，控制的，管制的
（受某团体或用某种方式）管理的，控制的，操纵的
en: done or arranged in a very careful way
ex: a controlled explosion
控制爆破

zh: 管制经济（由政府控制国家工业并决定产品的种类与数量）
en: a type of economic system in which a government controls its country’s industries and decides what goods should be produced and in what amounts

zh: a scientific experiment in which only one condition is changed in each of several tests in order to find out what effect that condition has on the results of the experiment
en: a scientific experiment in which only one condition is changed in each of several tests in order to find out what effect that condition has on the results of the experiment
ex: Controlled experiments show how shore crabs of different sizes respond to ship noise.
对照实验表明，不同尺寸的岸蟹如何应对轮船噪声。

en: an illegal drug
ex: to be arrested for possession of a controlled substance
因藏有毒品而被捕

zh: （尤指大型机构或部门的）管理者，控制者，指挥者
（机器或部件的）控制器，调节器
en: a person who manages or directs something, especially a large organization or part of an organization
ex: He is the new programme controller for BBC2.
他是英国广播公司第二频道的新任节目总监。

en: the fact of owning enough shares in a company to be able to make decisions about what the company should do
ex: In May 1948, Hughes purchased a controlling interest in RKO Studios.
1948年5月，休斯购买了RKO Studios的控股权。

en: causing a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement
ex: a highly controversial topic
颇有争议的话题

en: in a way that causes a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement
ex: Punishments for prisoners include loss of privileges and, more controversially, the stopping of visits.
对囚犯的惩罚包括丧失特别待遇，以及更具争议的禁止探视。

en: public discussion and argument about something that many people strongly disagree about, think is bad, or are shocked by
ex: to arouse/cause controversy
引起争论

en: to say or prove that something is not true
ex: This statement is controverted by the evidence.
该陈述受到证据的质疑。

zh: 藐视权威的；违抗的；不服从的
en: having no respect for authority
an injury to part of the body that does not break the skin
ex: There were multiple contusions and abrasions on his face and arm.
他的脸和手臂上有多个挫伤和擦伤。

zh: 令人迷惑的难题；复杂难解的问题
en: a confusing problem or question that is very difficult to solve
ex: The role of clouds is one of the big conundrums of climatology.
云的作用是气候学的一大难题。

zh: （有卫星城镇的）大都市，集合城市
en: a large area where towns have grown and joined together, often around a city
ex: The region has several medium-sized towns and cities, but no major conurbations.
那个地区有几个中等规模的城镇，但没有大的都市。

en: to spend time getting your health and strength back after an illness
ex: She is convalescing at home after her operation.
手术后她正在家休养康复。

en: a period of time when you get well again after an illness or a medical operation; the process of getting well
ex: You need four to six weeks' convalescence.
你需要四至六个星期的康复期。

zh: 康复期的；正在康复的；渐愈的
en: a person who is getting well again after an illness or a medical operation
ex: I treated him as a convalescent, not as a sick man.
我把他当作正在康复的人，而不是病人。

zh: （热通过气体或液体的）运流，对流
en: the process in which heat moves through a gas or a liquid as the hotter part rises and the cooler, heavier part sinks
ex: convection currents
对流气流

zh: an oven with a fan that moves hot air around to heat food in an even way
en: an oven with a fan that moves hot air around to heat food in an even way
ex: Heat a convection oven to 225°F or a conventional oven to 250°F.
将对流烤箱加热到225°F或将常规烤箱加热到250°F。

en: a device for heating the air in a room using convection
to arrange for people to come together for a formal meeting
ex: to convene a meeting
召开会议

zh: （工厂或基层单位的）资深工会领导人
en: a person who arranges meetings of groups or committees
ex: He is national convener of the Campaign Against Child Labour.
他是反对童工运动的全国召集人。

zh: 便利的事物（或设施）；方便的用具
en: the quality of being useful, easy or suitable for somebody
ex: We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.
为方便顾客我们备有座位。

en: food that you buy frozen or in a box or can and that you can prepare and cook very quickly and easily
ex: Convenience foods can make life easier.
方便食品可以使生活更轻松。

zh: 便利店（常为 24 小时营业）
en: a small local shop that sells food, newspapers, etc. and has long opening hours
ex: We bought some snacks at the convenience store.
我们在便利店买了一些小吃。

zh: 实用的；便利的；方便的；省事的
附近的；近便的；容易到达的
en: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
ex: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.
水果是维生素和能量的便利来源。

zh: 实用的；便利的；方便的；省事的
附近的；近便的；容易到达的
en: in a way that is useful, easy or quick to do; in a way that does not cause problems
ex: The report can be conveniently divided into three main sections.
这份报告不用费事就可划分为三个主要部分。

zh: （工厂或基层单位的）资深工会领导人
en: a person who arranges meetings of groups or committees
a building in which a Christian community of nuns (= members of a female religious community) live together
ex: She entered a convent at the age of sixteen.
她 16 岁当了修女。

zh: （从业者、政党成员等的）大会，集会
（国家或首脑间的）公约，协定，协议
（文学、艺术或戏剧的）传统手法，传统风格
en: the way in which something is done that most people in a society expect and consider to be polite or the right way to do it
ex: the rigid social conventions of Victorian Britain
英国维多利亚时期僵化的社会习俗

zh: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的
en: tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
ex: conventional behaviour/morality
循规蹈矩的行为；传统的道德规范

zh: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的
en: the fact of tending to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; the fact of being normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
ex: They refused the conventionality of bourgeois life, and worked among artists and poets.
他们拒绝了资产阶级生活的传统，并在艺术家和诗人中间工作。

zh: 依照惯例的；遵循习俗的；墨守成规的；普通平凡的
en: in a way that tends to follow what is done or considered acceptable by society in general; in a way that is normal and ordinary, and perhaps not very interesting
ex: conventionally dressed
衣着传统的

en: a person who is attending a convention (= large meeting)

zh: （思想、政策、目标等）十分相似，相同
en: to move towards a place from different directions and meet
ex: Thousands of supporters converged on London for the rally.
成千上万的支持者从四面八方汇聚伦敦举行集会。

zh: the process of moving together from different directions and meeting; the point where this happens
the process of becoming very similar or the same
en: the process of moving together from different directions and meeting; the point where this happens
ex: The city was a natural point of convergence for river-based traffic.
该市是河流交通的天然汇合点。

zh: （思想、政策、目标等）十分相似，相同
en: moving together from different directions and meeting
ex: convergent lines
相互会合的线条

en: knowing about something; familiar with something
ex: You need to become fully conversant with the company's procedures.
你得对公司的程序了如指掌。

en: an informal talk involving a small group of people or only two; the activity of talking in this way
ex: a phone conversation
电话交谈

zh: 人物风俗画；乡村（或室内）风情画
en: an object that is talked about a lot because it is unusual

zh: 噎人的话；令人瞠目结舌的话
en: a remark that is unexpected or that shocks people so that they do not know how to reply to it

zh: 非正式的；用于交谈的；口语的
en: not formal; as used in conversation
ex: a casual and conversational tone
不拘礼节的谈话语气

en: a person who is good at talking to others, especially in an informal way
ex: Reynolds was a notable conversationalist.
雷诺兹是一位著名的对话家。

zh: 非正式的；用于交谈的；口语的
en: in a way that is not formal; as used in conversation
ex: ‘Have you been here long?’ he asked conversationally.
“你来这里很久了吗？” 他攀谈着问道。

en: to have a conversation with somebody
ex: She conversed with the Romanians in French.
她用法语与罗马尼亚人交谈。

en: in a way that is the opposite of something
ex: You can add the fluid to the powder, or, conversely, the powder to the fluid.
可把液体加入粉末，或者相反，把粉末加入液体。

zh: （宗教或信仰的）改变；皈依；归附
（持球过对方球门线触地或达阵后的）附加得分
en: the act or process of changing something from one form, use or system to another
ex: Their main business is the conversion of farm buildings into family homes.
他们的主要业务是将农场建筑物改建为家庭住宅。

en: a vehicle in which the back part behind the driver has been arranged as a living space

zh: （使）改变（宗教或信仰）；（使）皈依，归附
en: to change or make something change from one form, purpose, system, etc. to another
ex: They took just nine months to convert the building.
他们只花了九个月的时间便将大楼改建。

zh: 使发生转化的人（或物）；转换器
en: a person or thing that converts something
ex: a catalytic converter
催化转换器

zh: 可改变的；可转换的；可兑换的
en: the ability to be changed to a different form or use
ex: There were limitations on the convertibility of national currencies into dollars.
本国货币兑美元的兑换存在限制。

zh: 可改变的；可转换的；可兑换的
en: that can be changed to a different form or use
ex: a convertible sofa (= one that can be used as a bed)
可当作床用的沙发

en: curving out
ex: a convex lens/mirror
凸透镜；凸镜

en: the quality of being convex (= curving out)
to make ideas, feelings, etc. known to somebody
ex: Colours like red convey a sense of energy and strength.
红色之类的颜色可给人以充满活力与力量的感觉。

en: the process of taking somebody/something from one place to another
ex: the conveyance of goods by rail
由火车运输货物

en: a lawyer who is an expert in conveyancing
the branch of law that involves preparing the documents needed for moving property from one owner to another

zh: 传送带，输送带（如输送工厂的产品或机场的行李）
运送者；传送者；传播者；传达者
en: a continuous moving band used for transporting goods from one part of a building to another, for example products in a factory or bags, cases, etc. in an airport
ex: The products are labelled as they pass by on the conveyor.
产品在传送带上经过时被贴上标签。
